hero.heading: We're Getting Married!
hero.notFoundMessage: We couldn't find your invitation. Please check the link you were given, or reach out to the couple directly.

paragraphs.text: What started as a chance meeting on a rainy afternoon turned into years of laughter, quiet Sunday mornings, and countless little adventures. We found in each other a best friend, a partner, and a home.
"Every love story is beautiful, but ours is our favorite."
Now, surrounded by the people who mean the most to us, we're ready to begin our next chapter together — and we would be overjoyed to have you there with us.

calendar.closing: Join us for a day full of joy, love, and unforgettable memories.

rsvp.heading: Please Let Us Know If You'll Be Joining Us
rsvp.subtext: Your presence means the world to us. Please RSVP so we can prepare a seat with your name on it.

footer.text: Thank you for being part of our journey. We can't wait to celebrate with you!
